is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses exclusively on the mosquito Culex quinquefasciatus (Title, Abstract, and Page 5).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study uses a pyrethroid-susceptible laboratory strain and does not report genotyping for any resistance markers (Page 5).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype data is reported; the study only reports mortality results from bioassays (Results section).

african_field_population.evidence: The mosquitoes used are from the CMAVE laboratory strain, which was isolated from Gainesville, Florida, USA, in 1995 (Page 5).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study reporting experimental bioassay results (Materials & Methods).

sub_country_location.evidence: The origin of the laboratory strain is specified as Gainesville, Florida (Page 5).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study reports experimental results conducted under controlled conditions, likely within a short timeframe prior to publication (2026).

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is an independent laboratory study using a standard reference strain.

supplement.evidence: No genotype data is expected in the supplement as the study uses a susceptible laboratory strain.

assessment.summary: This study investigates how temperature and relative humidity influence the toxicity of deltamethrin and malathion against a laboratory strain of Culex quinquefasciatus from the USA. It does not study Anopheles mosquitoes, does not report genotype data for resistance markers, and does not use African field populations.
